info.title: com.shopware.quote
info.description:
Buyer-facing B2B Request-for-Quote capability for Shopware shops. Protocol-neutral: any buyer agent can use it.

## Authentication and authorization

Two mechanisms are supported; the OAuth mechanism is **preferred** whenever the shop advertises it.

### OAuth 2.0 Bearer token (preferred, standardized)

When the shop's discovery profile lists the `dev.ucp.common.identity_linking` capability, agents SHOULD obtain an OAuth 2.0 access token with scope `quote` and send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Endpoints (authorization, token, and dynamic client registration per RFC 7591 - agents can self-register a client) are discovered via the RFC 8414 metadata document referenced in that capability's `config.metadata`. The customer grants consent once in the shop's own UI; the token then proves both the agent's identity and the customer's authorization in one credential. Requests carry **no buyer claim** - the token names the customer. Failures: HTTP 401 `invalid_token` (invalid, expired, or revoked), HTTP 403 `insufficient_scope` (token lacks the `quote` scope).

### Signed request + buyer claim (fallback)

1. **Agent authentication** - send a `UCP-Agent` header (`profile="https://<agent-platform>/.well-known/ucp"`) and a `Request-Signature` header signed with a key published in the agent platform's profile. The shop verifies the signature and may enforce a domain whitelist. Failure: HTTP 403, code `unauthorized`.
2. **Acting on behalf of a customer** - the request carries a buyer claim (`buyer.email` and/or `buyer.customer_number` in POST bodies; `buyer_email` / `buyer_customer_number` query parameters on GET). The shop resolves the customer server-side; agents never hold customer credentials. The verified agent platform domain must have an unrevoked authorization record for that customer (managed by the merchant), and the customer must have the Quote Management feature enabled.

Enforcement order and machine-readable error codes:

| Check | HTTP | code |
|---|---|---|
| Capability not installed/licensed on this shop | 404 | `quote_unavailable` (capability is also absent from /.well-known/ucp) |
| Bearer token invalid, expired, or revoked | 401 | `invalid_token` |
| Bearer token lacks `quote` scope | 403 | `insufficient_scope` |
| Agent signature/whitelist fails (fallback mechanism) | 403 | `unauthorized` |
| Buyer claim resolves to no customer (or token subject unknown) | 404 | `buyer_not_found` |
| Agent not authorized for this customer (fallback mechanism) | 403 | `agent_not_authorized` |
| Customer lacks Quote Management flag | 403 | `quote_not_enabled_for_buyer` |
| Quote id unknown or owned by another customer | 404 | `B2B__QUOTE_NOT_FOUND` (existence is never confirmed) |
| Accepting an expired or non-actionable quote | 400 | `CHECKOUT__QUOTE_CANNOT_PLACE_ORDER` |

## State machine

Buyer-visible states and who acts (full transition table in `x-state-machine`):

- `open` - request submitted, merchant's turn. Poll.
- `in_review` - merchant is processing. Poll.
- `replied` - merchant made an offer, **buyer's turn**: accept, counter, or decline.
- `change_requested` - buyer countered, merchant's turn. Poll.
- `accepted`, `declined`, `expired`, `withdrawn`, `cancelled` - terminal for the buyer.

## Expiration

Offers carry `expiration_date` (ISO 8601, always present in responses, may be null before the merchant replies). A quote can be auto-flagged `expired` by a background job; accepting an expired quote fails with HTTP 400 `CHECKOUT__QUOTE_CANNOT_PLACE_ORDER`. Agents must read `expiration_date` from the offer and act before it.

## Price semantics

All amounts are in the quote's `currency`. `totals.tax_status` states whether `totals.gross` (tax included) or `totals.net` is authoritative. Line item `unit_price`, `requested_unit_price` and counter-offer `requested_unit_price` are **per unit**. Requested prices are the buyer's ask; the merchant's offer is reflected in `unit_price`/`totals` after the quote reaches `replied`.

## Async negotiation

The merchant side (possibly automated) responds out-of-band. Agents poll `GET /ucp/quotes/{id}` for state changes; recommended polling interval: 300 seconds (see `x-polling-interval-seconds`). Webhooks are not part of this capability version.

expired.note: merchant may extend expiration back to replied

transitions.note: performed automatically inside POST /ucp/quotes; draft is never exposed

post.summary: Request a quote (RFQ). Creates and submits the request in one call; the returned quote is in state `open`.

get.summary: Read a quote snapshot (state, line items with offered prices, totals, expiration_date, comments). Only quotes owned by the resolved customer are visible; anything else is 404.

post.summary: Counter-offer: new per-line requested unit prices and/or a comment. Valid only in state `replied`; transitions to `change_requested`.
Accept the offer. Accepting IS ordering: executes the quote-to-order flow and returns the order reference. Valid only in state `replied` and before expiration_date.

400.description: Not acceptable in current state or expired (code CHECKOUT__QUOTE_CANNOT_PLACE_ORDER)

post.summary: Decline the offer with an optional comment. Valid only in state `replied`.

oauth2IdentityLinking.description: Preferred when the shop advertises dev.ucp.common.identity_linking. Discover the concrete authorization, token, and RFC 7591 dynamic client registration endpoints via the RFC 8414 metadata document referenced in that capability's config.metadata (served at /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server). The token replaces the buyer claim: its subject is the customer the agent acts for.

scopes.quote: Request, read, counter, accept, and decline quotes on the customer's behalf

ucpAgentSignature.name: Request-Signature
ucpAgentSignature.description: Detached signature over the raw request body, verifiable against the signing keys published in the agent platform's /.well-known/ucp profile referenced by the UCP-Agent header.

quoteId.name: id
quoteId.description: Quote id (UUID hex). Ids are unguessable but treated as secrets of the owning customer: foreign ids return 404.

Buyer.description: Buyer claim for the signature fallback mechanism; at least one identifier is required there. Omit entirely when authenticating with an OAuth Bearer token - the token names the customer.

BuyerOnlyRequest.description: buyer is required only with the signature fallback mechanism

requested_unit_price.description: Buyer's asking price per unit, in the shop's customer-facing currency

items.description: Reference an existing quote line by id (preferred) or product_id

id.description: Quote line item id from GET /ucp/quotes/{id}

expiration_date.description: Always present. Accept before this instant; null means the merchant has not set one yet (the quote may still be expired by a background job).

currency.description: ISO 4217 code; all amounts in this document are in this currency

tax_status.description: Which total is the customer-facing authoritative amount

requested_unit_price.description: Buyer's last ask per unit, if any
